answer: Farming becomes a signal bet on surviving 56 epochs of grading, and every reef settlement recomputes the tide schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 56 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 17 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
